candidates.name: Stroke

NIH Stroke Scale score on admission was 10

candidates.why: The patient presented with symptoms consistent with a stroke, including left-sided weakness, facial paresis, and difficulty speaking.

candidates.name: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
support_spans: platelet count declined to 21 × 10^3/μL
schistocytes on peripheral blood smear
elevated LDH and indirect bilirubin
candidates.why: The patient's declining platelet count, presence of schistocytes, and elevated LDH and indirect bilirubin are consistent with thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura.
